outcome.action: Adopted

pulled.summary: Adopted in its own vote on March 31 (5–1, 1 abstaining), instead of with the rest of the consent report.

items.title: Appointment - Member, Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission - President, Board of Education

enrichment.headline: Hires ENGEO for up to $110,015 in soil and seismic studies for the Laurel Child Development Center
enrichment.summary: The district hires engineering firm ENGEO to study soil and earthquake hazards for the Laurel Child Development Center Replacement Project. The work includes soil borings, cone penetration tests, sample collection, lab testing and written reports. The not-to-exceed amount of $110,015.00 includes an $8,000.00 contingency, and the work runs March 25, 2021 through March 24, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Engineering Services Agreement - ENGEO – Laurel Child Development Center Replacement Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $16,940 and 466 days for Jensen Hughes fire alarm testing on the Fremont construction project
enrichment.summary: This changes the agreement with Jensen Hughes for the Fremont New Construction Project. It adds $16,940.00, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $86,430.00 to $103,370.00, to pay for extra site visits to witness a fire alarm re-test and a combined fire and intrusion alarm meeting. It also extends the term, which had ended December 31, 2020, to April 10, 2022.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 3, Independent Consultant Agreement - Jensen Hughes - Fremont New Construction Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Hires Sandis for $28,835 in site surveys for the Laurel Child Development Center
enrichment.summary: The district hires Sandis Civil Engineering Surveyors Planners for site survey work at the Laurel Child Development Center project: a boundary survey, a topographic survey, utility locating and base map preparation. The $28,835.00 includes a $3,000.00 contingency, and the agreement runs March 25, 2021 through March 24, 2024.
